symbols.name: axis index
symbols.meaning: The index of an axis, running from 1 to d.
symbols.quote: Let $d$ be the number of axes, with $\alpha$ and $\beta$ running from $1$ to $d$ as axis indices (not list positions), and let $s_\alpha$ be the length of axis $\alpha$, with $s_1,\ldots,s_d$ pairwise coprime.

symbols.name: second axis index
symbols.meaning: A second axis index, running from 1 to d.
symbols.quote: Let $d$ be the number of axes, with $\alpha$ and $\beta$ running from $1$ to $d$ as axis indices (not list positions), and let $s_\alpha$ be the length of axis $\alpha$, with $s_1,\ldots,s_d$ pairwise coprime.

symbols.name: axis length
symbols.meaning: The number of positions along axis alpha.
symbols.quote: Let $d$ be the number of axes, with $\alpha$ and $\beta$ running from $1$ to $d$ as axis indices (not list positions), and let $s_\alpha$ be the length of axis $\alpha$, with $s_1,\ldots,s_d$ pairwise coprime.

symbols.name: axis variable
symbols.meaning: The formal variable of axis alpha, whose powers index the positions on that axis.
symbols.quote: Let $x_\alpha$ be the variable of axis $\alpha$, and let $\mathcal R=\mathbb C[x_1,\ldots,x_d]/(x_1^{s_1}-1,\ldots,x_d^{s_d}-1)$ be the target ring.

symbols.name: target ring
symbols.meaning: The ring of polynomials in the axis variables modulo x_alpha^{s_alpha}-1 for each axis alpha.
symbols.quote: Let $x_\alpha$ be the variable of axis $\alpha$, and let $\mathcal R=\mathbb C[x_1,\ldots,x_d]/(x_1^{s_1}-1,\ldots,x_d^{s_d}-1)$ be the target ring.

symbols.name: prefix product
symbols.meaning: The product of the lengths of the axes before axis alpha.

symbols.name: coefficient index
symbols.meaning: The position of a coefficient in the list, running from 0 to S-1.
symbols.quote: For a coefficient index $\lambda$ with $0\le\lambda<S$ (the position of a coefficient in the list), $\Phi(x^\lambda)=\prod_\alpha x_\alpha^{\mu_\alpha\lambda}$ is a monomial whose exponent on $x_\alpha$ is $b_\alpha$, where $0\le b_\alpha<s_\alpha$ and $b_\alpha\equiv\mu_\alpha\lambda\pmod{s_\alpha}$.

symbols.name: axis digit
symbols.meaning: The digit of the coefficient index on axis alpha, running from 0 to s_alpha minus 1.
symbols.quote: Here $\delta_\beta$ is the digit of $\lambda$ on axis $\beta$, and $\delta_\alpha$ means the same with $\alpha$ in place of $\beta$.

symbols.name: axis coordinate
symbols.meaning: The coordinate on axis alpha of the image of a coefficient index, which is the exponent of x_alpha in the image monomial.
symbols.quote: For a coefficient index $\lambda$ with $0\le\lambda<S$ (the position of a coefficient in the list), $\Phi(x^\lambda)=\prod_\alpha x_\alpha^{\mu_\alpha\lambda}$ is a monomial whose exponent on $x_\alpha$ is $b_\alpha$, where $0\le b_\alpha<s_\alpha$ and $b_\alpha\equiv\mu_\alpha\lambda\pmod{s_\alpha}$.

relations.quote: The Chinese-remainder axis map is a bijection that places the coefficients of a [Cyclic convolution](cyclic-convolution.md) on the axes of a product of cyclic rings, so that the convolution becomes multidimensional.

Let $\Phi$ be the algebra map (respecting sums, products and scalars) with $\Phi(x)=\prod_\alpha x_\alpha^{\mu_\alpha}$ that maps $\mathbb C[x]/(x^S-1)$ into the [Quotient ring by several relations](quotient-ring.md) $\mathcal R$.
